annotations.title: Read the projection of an Italian comune with uncertainty and reliability

description: Reads the statistical projection of one Italian municipality (comune) for the year after the latest ISTAT year: total, hotel and non-hotel nights and arrivals. Use it when you have the 6-digit `cod_istat` from cerca_comune and the question is what to expect next; do not use it for past figures (use leggi_serie_comune instead) or to set comuni side by side (use confronta_comuni instead). Each line gives last year's real figure, the projected figure and `affidabilita_pct` (0 to 100, measured by projecting a past year), and only the total has the p10 to p90 uncertainty band; a line that fails the checks has `disponibile` false and a `motivo`, a comune without a yearly series returns an empty list in `linee` with a `nota`, and a missing figure is null. These are estimates, not official statistics, and they are served only while the site shows projections to everyone, otherwise the call returns an error. Read-only, public, no authentication; 30 requests per minute per client, shared across tools.

cod_istat.description: 6-digit ISTAT code of the comune as a string, leading zeros kept ("058091" is Roma); it comes from cerca_comune. An unknown code returns an error that says what to pass.

name: leggi_previsioni_comune

anno_orizzonte.description: The one year projected: the year after the latest year with ISTAT yearly figures. Null when no projection is stored for this comune (see `nota`).

cod_istat.description: 6-digit ISTAT code of the comune, as a string with leading zeros kept.

fonte.description: Source to cite with the figures: processed by DatiTuristici.it from institutional data (ISTAT).

linee.description: The four lines in the order totale, alberghieri, extra, arrivi; an empty list when no projection is stored for this comune (see `nota`).

affidabilita_pct.description: Reliability from 0 to 100: 100 minus the percent error the model made when it projected `anno_di_prova` from the earlier years only, floored at 0. Null when the line is not available or too few earlier years allowed the test (see `nota`).

anno_di_prova.description: The year on which the reliability was measured; null when the line is not available.

disponibile.description: True when this line has a projection; false when it was rejected (see `motivo`) and its numbers are null.

linea.description: What is projected: totale = nights spent in all establishments, alberghieri = nights in hotels, extra = nights in non-hotel establishments, arrivi = guest arrivals.

motivo.description: Why the line is not projected, null when it is: nessun_dato = no figure in the recent years the check looks at; serie_corta = a recent year is missing; zeri = a recent year is zero; salto = a jump between consecutive years too large to project from (the 2025 change of ISTAT scope is not counted as a jump); senza_totale = the line itself passes but `totale` does not, and every other line is anchored to it.

p10.description: Lower end of the uncertainty band: the 10th percentile of the model's forecast or, when `nota` says the total adds any months ISTAT has already published, those months (if any) plus the sum of the monthly 10th percentiles of the projected months, a wider band than a plain 10th percentile. Only the line totale has it; null for the others.

p90.description: Upper end of the uncertainty band: the 90th percentile of the model's forecast or, when `nota` says the total adds any months ISTAT has already published, those months (if any) plus the sum of the monthly 90th percentiles of the projected months, a wider band than a plain 90th percentile. Only the line totale has it; null for the others.

proiettato.description: The projected figure for `anno_orizzonte` (nights, or arrivals for the line arrivi). For totale it is the median of the model's forecast for the year or, when `nota` says the total adds any months ISTAT has already published, those months (if any) plus the projected remaining months. alberghieri, extra and arrivi may be derived from the total, as `nota` says. Null when the line is not available.

reale_anno_prima.description: The real figure of the year before `anno_orizzonte`, the latest year with ISTAT figures, to set beside `proiettato`; null when the line is not available.

metodo.description: Name of the statistical model that made the projections; null when none is stored.

nota.description: Notes in English on reading the projection: what it is, how the total and its band are built when the year adds any months ISTAT has already published, which lines are not projected and why, which may be derived from the total, where reliability is missing, and the change of ISTAT scope in 2025. When no projection is stored, it says so.

scheda.description: Link to the comune's public page on datituristici.it, to cite.

soglia_affidabilita_bassa.description: Reliability percentage below which the site labels a projection as low; null when no projection is stored.

title: Read the projection of an Italian comune with uncertainty and reliability
